subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB331
title: Directs the State Department of Fish and Wildlife to manage hatchery produced and naturally produced salmon and steelhead in a watershed as a single population.
headline: SB 331 did not pass

claims.text: SB 331 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
